title_en: Apple TV's September Lineup Includes a Ryan Reynolds Movie and a Matthew McConaughey Series Alongside a Price Increase
body_en:
Apple TV may have just raised its prices again , but the change isn't all that surprising with what the streamer has coming in September. Continuing its commitment to high-quality Apple TV Originals , the upcoming release schedule is absolutely star-studded with talent.
You can check out what's premiering on the service in September below, or jump ahead to the full release schedule by day.
Mayday is described as an action comedy film set during the height of the Cold War. It stars Ryan Reynolds as a a hot-shot U.S. Navy Pilot known as Lieutenant Troy "Assassin" Kelly who gets stranded behind enemy lines. He's discovered by ex-KGB agent Nikolai Ustinov (Kenneth Branagh), who just so happens to hold a certain reverence for American culture. The result is an unlikely buddy spy movie that looks to mix action with comedy.
If the trailer isn't enough of a preview for you, you can also check out IGN's exclusive clip from the film for additional details.
The first new Apple TV series of September is a six-part adaptation of Ryan David Jahn's novel The Dispatcher . The story follows former detective Ian Ridley (Patrick Brammall), who is still pretty messed up since his daughter Maggie disappeared over a decade ago. Now Ridley is working as a police dispatcher when he receives a distress call from a teenage girl that he thinks could be his long lost daughter.
You'll likely recognize Brammall as the Australian love interest in this year's Devil Wear's Prada 2
Slow Horses is entering its sixth season this month, but it's already been officially renewed for Season 7. If you're not already deep into this series, there's never a wrong time to dive right in. With Gary Oldman pretty much extending his terrific performance in Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy into this series. Here's what we said about the Season 1 premiere back in 2022:
"The premiere of Apple TV's Slow Horses sets up a sharp spy thriller centering on an excellent performance by Gary Oldman. The timely drama blends dark humor and tense action for a novel ensemble spin on the genre." - Samantha Nelson
For those who are caught up, the latest Season 6 trailer features the return of Olivia Cooke's fan favorite character .
You may have seen the rumors floating around over the years that Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson are actually secretly related . While the pair has never publicly confirmed this to be true, they are seemingly taking advantage of those rumors with this new series. Brothers is a comedy in which McConaughey and Harrelson play fictional versions of themselves. The series explores a friendship between the two and what happens when the secret that they might actually be brothers is revealed.
The series premiere will include the first two episodes, followed by new episodes every Wednesday.
Alongside the new releases for September, Apple TV is continuing to put out new episodes of Ted Lasso Season 4 , Dark Matter Season 2, and Women in Blue. This upcoming Friday we will also be getting the Silo Season 3 finale , setting us up for the sci-fi series' final season next year. Here's the full release schedule by day:
Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, he has considered the Northwest his home for his entire life. With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics -- from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .
